# Yishog Integrated Services Limited

> Industrial transmission and conveyor belt solutions — timing belts, conveyor belts, vee belts, modular plastic chain, stainless steel belts, mesh belts, hoses and Habasit flat belts.

## Company

Yishog Integrated Services Limited is a Lagos, Nigeria-based industrial distributor with 15+ years of experience supplying precision transmission belts and hoses to manufacturers across Nigeria and West Africa.

- Address: 17B Debo-Aina Crescent, Off Adeyemo Akapo Street, Omole Phase 1, Ojodu-Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria
- Phone: +234 809 199 9991 / +234 802 304 7845
- Email: sale@yishog.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–5pm, Sat 9am–2pm

## Products

- [Timing Belts](https://yishog.com/timing-belts.html): Imperial (MXL, XL, L, H, XH, XXH) and Metric (HTD, GT2/GT3) synchronous belts
- [Toothed Belts](https://yishog.com/toothed-belts.html): Neoprene and polyurethane positive-drive belts
- [Conveyor Belts](https://yishog.com/conveyor-belts.html): Flat, chevron and cleated rubber/PVC/PU belts
- [Double Sided Timing Belts](https://yishog.com/double-sided-timing-belts.html): Twin-power belts for serpentine drives
- [Transmission Belts](https://yishog.com/transmission-belts.html): Flat, wedge and multi-rib (Poly-V) drive belts
- [Vee Belts](https://yishog.com/vee-belts.html): Classical A, B, C, D, E sections; wrapped and raw-edge
- [Modular Plastic Chain Belts](https://yishog.com/modular-plastic-chain-belts.html): PP/POM interlocking modules for food and packaging
- [Stainless Steel Belts](https://yishog.com/stainless-steel-belts.html): Solid SS304/SS316 and mesh belts for high-temperature/hygienic use
- [Mesh Belts](https://yishog.com/mesh-belts.html): Balanced spiral and compound balanced metal mesh
- [Balance Belts](https://yishog.com/balance-belts.html): Symmetric spiral-link conveyor belts
- [Hoses](https://yishog.com/hoses.html): Steam, air and high-pressure hydraulic hoses
- [Habasit Hot Press Belts](https://yishog.com/habasit-hot-press.html): Flat belts and hot press belting for woodworking and laminating

## Industries Served

Aluminium Extrusion, Automotives & Tires, Ceramic/Glass/Brick/Stone, Commercial & Domestic Appliances, Construction & Heavy Industry, Elevators, Energy, Fitness Equipment, Food Industries, Lawn/Garden/Agriculture, Material Handling, Textile & Non-Woven Production
